mapper.sql:
FROM candidates c LEFT JOIN cvs cv ON cv.id = (SELECT MAX(x.id) FROM cvs x WHERE x.candidate_id = c.id AND x.is_deleted = FALSE) WHERE c.is_deleted = FALSE
AND (LOWER(c.full_name) LIKE #{f.keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR LOWER(c.email) LIKE #{f.keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR c.phone LIKE #{f.keyword} ESCAPE '\' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cvs kx WHERE kx.candidate_id = c.id AND kx.is_deleted = FALSE AND LOWER(kx.content_text) LIKE #{f.keyword} ESCAPE '\')
OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_skills ks WHERE ks.candidate_id = c.id AND ks.skill_id IN #{id}) )
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM candidate_skills cs WHERE cs.candidate_id = c.id AND cs.skill_id = #{skillId})
AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM applications ja WHERE ja.candidate_id = c.id AND ja.job_id = #{f.jobId} AND ja.is_deleted = FALSE)
AND c.source = #{f.source} AND cv.parse_status = #{f.parseStatus} AND c.is_duplicate = #{f.duplicate}
mapper.select:
SELECT c.id, c.full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.source, c.is_duplicate AS duplicate, c.created_at, cv.id AS latest_cv_id, cv.file_name AS latest_cv_file_name, cv.parse_status AS latest_cv_parse_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications a WHERE a.candidate_id = c.id AND a.is_deleted = FALSE) AS application_count
ORDER BY ${f.orderBy} LIMIT #{f.limit} OFFSET #{f.offset}

SELECT a.id, a.job_id, a.candidate_id, c.full_name AS candidate_name, c.email AS candidate_email, c.phone AS candidate_phone, a.status, a.source, a.applied_at, a.cv_id, cv.parse_status AS cv_parse_status FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id LEFT JOIN cvs cv ON cv.id = a.cv_id WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.candidate_id = #{candidateId} AND a.job_id = #{jobId} ORDER BY a.applied_at DESC, a.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM applications a JOIN candidates c ON c.id = a.candidate_id WHERE a.job_id = #{jobId} AND a.is_deleted = FALSE AND c.is_deleted = FALSE
SELECT a.job_id AS key_id, COUNT(*) AS value_id FROM applications a WHERE a.is_deleted = FALSE AND a.job_id IN #{id} GROUP BY a.job_id
